# Changelog

The shape of digline's CHANGELOG.md that tools/hooks/home.py reads, kept small.
A plugin's heading sits above the core's on purpose: the hook must skip it, as
it skips Unreleased, and take the first `## X.Y.Z — YYYY-MM-DD`.
